!**************************************************************************************************
! ======================================== Model Namelists ========================================
!**************************************************************************************************

 &fv_core_nml
    layout = 1,1       ! Layout of processor: total cpu core = 6*layout1*layout2
    reference_sfc_pres = 705., ! Reference sfc pressure for nominal vertical grid in output [Pa]
    p_ref = 705.,              ! Reference sfc pressure [Pa] used to define vertical grid aks
    dry_mass = 705.,           ! Initial co2 mass [Pa]
    npx = 25,                 ! Number of cell boundaries per tile, x-direction. Resolution is ~360/4*22
    npy = 25,                 ! Number of cell boundaries per tile, y-direction. Resolution is ~360/4*22
    npz = 56,                 ! Number of vertical layers to use; tabulates ak, bk values specified
                                !   in FV_eta.F90
    npz_rst = 0          ! If nonzero, specifies number of vertical layers in the restart file.
                                !   Default = 0
    ntiles = 6,                 ! Number of tiles that make up the globe. Default = 6
    k_split = 3,             ! Frequency (per timestep [DTA; dt_atmos]) of vertical remapping.
                                !   Double if resolution is doubled
    n_split = 8,             ! Frequency (per k_split) of advective timestep
    fill = T,                   ! FLAG: Fill negative tracers
    n_sponge = 0,               ! Number of dynamic sponge layers
    d2_bg_k1 = 0.2,             ! Sponge layer del-2 divergence factor 1
    d2_bg_k2 = 0.04,            ! Sponge layer del-2 divergence factor 2
    nord = 3,               ! Divergence damping order (3 is del-8).
                                !   = 3 for c24
                                !   = 2 for c48
                                !   = 1 for c96+
    d4_bg = 0.15,               ! Coefficient for background del-4(6) divergence damping
    d_ext = 0.00,               ! Coefficient for external (barotropic) mode damping. Default is 0.02
    print_freq = -1,            ! Frequency for the diagnostics integral in the ascii output files
    beta = 0.2,                 ! Bluntness of topographic features
    kord_tm = -10,              ! Controls the order of the advection scheme for various variables
    kord_mt = 10,               ! Vertical mapping option for U, V
    kord_wz = 10,               ! Vertical mapping option for W
    kord_tr = 10,               ! Vertical mapping option for tracers
    hord_mt = 10,               ! Horizontal transport option for U, V
    hord_tm = 10,               ! Horizontal transport option for T
    hord_vt = 10,               ! Horizontal transport option for vort
    hord_dp = 10,               ! Horizontal transport option for delp
    nwat = 0,                   ! Number of water constituents
    hord_tr = 12,               ! Horizontal transport option of tracers
    is_ideal_case = T,          ! Cold start
/

 &main_nml
    days = 100,       ! Number of days to simulate in this run (set using dayslist)
    dt_atmos = 231     ! Physics timestep [sec]. Use integer sec between 2 timesteps.
                        !   Dynamical timestep then = dt_atmos/(nsplit * ksplit)
/

 &surface_data_nml
    do_co2_condensation = T,    ! FLAG: CO2 condensation at sfc. Maintains sfc T at or above Tcrit
/

!**************************************************************************************************
! ======================================== Physics Namelists ======================================
!**************************************************************************************************

 &mars_physics_nml
    do_co2_condensation_cycle = T,  ! FLAG: Do mass feedback from CO2 condensation (atm+srf)
    do_co2_condensation = T,        ! FLAG: CO2 condensation T adjustment in the atmosphere,
                                    !   deposited at sfc. Allows latent heating to be toggled.
                                    !   CO2 cycle controlled by 3 variables; 2 in mars_physics.
                                    !   If do_co2_condesnation_cycle = F, CO2 cap formation still
                                    !   allowed, it influences T and albedos, but mass source/sink
                                    !   does not affect the pressure cycle.
    GW_drag_TOG = 0,                ! Toggle for gravity wave drag
                                    !   = 0 for none
                                    !   = 1 for Palmer orographic gravity waves
                                    !   = 2 for Alexander and Dunkerton non-orographic waves
    rayleighModelTop_flag = T,      ! FLAG: apply Rayleigh damping near the top of the model boundary
/

!**************************************************************************************************
! ======================================= Aerosols Namelists ======================================
!**************************************************************************************************

 &aerosol_util_nml
    Reff_backgd = 2.e-6,    ! Dust effective radius for lifting in the case of background scenario
    do_moment_water = T,
/

 &aerosol_nml
    do_inpt_dust_cycle = T, ! FLAG: Read dust scenario from an input file for lifting. Skipped if optical_depth_inpt <= 0.
    conrath_type = 1,       ! Conrath vertical extent.
                            !   0 = Conventional Conrath top
                            !   1 = Conrath with scaled ztop from dust scenario
/

 &dust_update_nml
    Background = T,         ! FLAG: Background dust mode
    interact = F,           ! FLAG: Interactive Dust Mode
/
 &microphys_nml
    microtimestep = 30,     ! Approx. timestep for nucleation and growth of cloud particles [sec]. If = -1, no timesplitting (microtimestep =dt_atmos)
    makeclouds = T,         ! FLAG: T = Enable cloud formation, F = disable.
    mteta = 0.95,           ! Contact parameter for nucleation (unitless; cosine of contact angle)
/
!**************************************************************************************************
! ==================================== Gravity Wave Drag Namelists ================================
!**************************************************************************************************

 &palmer_drag_nml
    grid_res = 24,        ! Closest grid resolution for the topography standard deviation
/

!**************************************************************************************************
! =================================== Radiative Transfer Namelists ================================
!**************************************************************************************************

 &ames_rtmod_nml
    radactive_dust_TOG = 1, ! Toggle for radiatively active dust
                            !   = 0 for clear
                            !   = 1 transported moment dust (defined by dust_update_nml flags)
                            !   = 2 not supported
                            !   = 3 prescribed fixed (defined by aerosol_nml flags)
    radactive_cloud = T,    ! FLAG: = T allows water ice clouds to be radiatively active
/

!**************************************************************************************************
! =================================== FV3 Internal Namelists ======================================
!**************************************************************************************************

 &fms_nml
    clock_grain = "LOOP",           ! Performance timer, default = loop level
    domains_stack_size = 4194304,   ! Number of words of MPP_DOMAINS user stack
    print_memory_usage = T,         ! Prints memory usage stats to the fms.out file
/

 &diag_manager_nml
    issue_oor_warnings = F,         ! FLAG: print out warning when zonal wind, meridional wind, or atmospheric temperature are outside of the range set in FV_diagnostics

 /

 &test_case_nml
    test_case = 11                  ! Topography type. 11 = Mars topo; 10 = flat topo
/

limitations: Wind RMS is the spatial RMS of the time-mean zonal component.
Common-pressure fields use column log-pressure interpolation of five-sol means, without extrapolation or horizontal remapping.
Dinosaur pressure uses mean surface pressure; native pressure uses saved mean delp. This is not the mean of fields interpolated at each model step.
Native geometric midpoint heights and Dinosaur isothermal reference heights have different definitions.
Five-sol transient cases do not establish climate convergence or isolated device throughput.
